snippet.title: HyperYuki: Snowboard Syndicate – #PlayAcclaim | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3082730/HYPERyuki_Snowboard_Syndicate

Welcome to the Snowboard Syndicate! Race, Compete, and Explore the slopes as a colorful cast of unique characters! But what’s snowboarding without a little bit of drip? Through exploring and racing, you can unlock cosmetics such as designs for your snowboard and clothes to make sure you shine the brightest while shredding.

Features
• 3 Game Modes:
• Challenge: HYPERyuki’s main game mode, where players must complete certain challenges in each level in order to progress.
• Race: Race against players or NPCs across each track
• Chill: Enjoy a calm experience, hanging around the tracks, enjoying the view, with an endless mode.
• Multiplayer: Compete against friends both online and in person! Play online with up to seven of your friends or play local multiplayer through split screen.
